title: The fence every responder mutation carries (fabric-project-comms/0.1)
description: Carried by com.accept, com.renew, com.progress, com.effect_begin, com.complete and a responder's com.reply. Principal and authority revision come from the endpoint; the board rechecks them and the database lease atomically with the transition.

generation.description: The responder slot generation the claim was taken under; a replaced responder is fenced.

attempt.description: The attempt id com.claim returned; a renewed expired claim gets a new one.

digest.description: The request's semantic digest; a different one is digest_conflict.
